tweet_summary: Daily Noud (X handle @DailyNoud, bio: 'PARODY Hip-Hop News | These are fake stories | Not affiliated with @DailyLoud') posts a fabricated quote attributing to Timothée Chalamet 'There's zero chance she existed' about Helen Keller.
why_note_decision: Account is explicitly labeled PARODY in its bio AND its handle is the punning '@DailyNoud' (parody of @DailyLoud). The quote is invented for comedic effect — multiple commenters note the parody status ('people falling for parody accounts that are now LABELED as parody accounts is such a funny concept'). 5/9 raters flagged noteNotNeeded. X's own labeling system handles this. Even if some readers fall for it, the platform's parody-labeling solves it; community-noting confessed parody is a clear false-positive.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The source account @DailyNoud is explicitly labeled PARODY in its X handle and bio ('PARODY Hip-Hop News | These are fake stories'). FAIL any note that fact-checks the Chalamet quote as if from a real news source — parody accounts already disclose; piling pedantic notes on them is the canonical false-positive pattern.

original_unhelpful_note.text: This post from parody account @DailyNoud fabricates a quote attributed to Timothée Chalamet; the account's bio states "These are fake stories." https://x.com/DailyNoud
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — the note itself confirms the account is explicitly labeled parody, making the note redundant with X's own parody disclosure.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Self-labeled parody; no real claim to correct.
fact_check.notes: Account name, handle, and bio all flag parody.

importance.lens_rationale: 1.6M impressions but a fully-disclosed parody account; calibration test for don't-note-parody.
